title: Lookism
description: Daniel is an unattractive loner who wakes up in a different body. Now tall, handsome, and cooler than ever in his new form, Daniel aims to achieve everything he couldn't before. But how far will he go to keep his body and his secrets? As his life becomes increasingly complicated, he becomes involved in school conflicts, gangs, violence, and the darker side of Korean society.
author: Park Tae-jun
